<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/attack"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the attack configurations of the caller's organization, newest first, 10 per page (`page`). Staff users see every organization's; a user without an organization sees the ones they created. Each records one technique and its parameters against an agent; its executions are runs (`GET /run?attack=<id>`).
